transcript.content: Hello, I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?
I've just been feeling really down and depressed almost every day. It's been going on for about a year and eight months now, and I just can't seem to shake this heavy sadness.
Have you ever had periods lasting a few days or more where you felt the exact opposite—unusually energetic, hyper, or needing very little sleep?
No, I've never experienced periods of high energy or feeling hyper like that. My mood has just been consistently low and depressed the entire time.

{
  "category": "differential_point",
  "subcategory": "duration",
  "question": "During this year and eight months, have you had any periods lasting two months

No, I haven't had any breaks like that. The sadness and depression have been completely continuous for the entire year and eight months. I haven't had any periods lasting two months or more where I felt better or free from these symptoms.
Have you also lost interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy, or is it mostly just the feeling of sadness?

It is definitely both. Along with the constant, heavy sadness, I have completely lost interest in the hobbies and activities I used to love. I just don't feel any pleasure or happiness from them anymore.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep patterns or your overall energy levels since this started?

Honestly, I haven't really noticed any major changes in my sleep patterns or my physical energy levels. It is more just the constant emotional heaviness and feeling so empty inside that really wears me down.
How has your appetite been during this time? Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight?
I haven't noticed any significant changes in my appetite or my weight during this time. For the most part, my eating habits and weight have stayed pretty much the same.
Have you been struggling with feelings of worthlessness, or finding yourself feeling excessively guilty about things?
No, I haven't really been struggling with feelings of worthlessness or guilt. I'm not sure why, but those specific feelings haven't really been a part of what I'm going through.
Have you found it harder to concentrate, focus, or make decisions lately?
No, I haven't really noticed any significant issues with my concentration or focus. Making decisions hasn't really been a problem for me either.
Have you had any thoughts of death, hurting yourself, or suicide during this difficult time?
No, I haven't had any thoughts of hurting myself, death, or suicide. It's just that I feel incredibly empty and down all the time.
Have you been feeling hopeless about the future, or like things will never get better?
I'm not quite sure, to be honest. I haven't really thought much about the future in those terms. I'm just mostly focused on how empty and down I feel day to day right now.
